encounters.deskAlert: Whip Fenrir Fang is leaning casually against your office doorframe.

n1.text: Welcome to Washington, Barnaby! Adorable bow tie. Quick orientation: H.R. 101 hits the floor shortly. Parents and Main Street want those streetlamps, and Leadership needs a crisp AYE. Don't get squeamish over the property-tax attachment.

choices.label: You got it, Whip. Put me down for an AYE.
I read every bill before committing—check back on the floor.
I answer to Maple Creek, not your whip sheet.

n2_deal.text: Good boy! Keep your word on the floor and Leadership will owe you a favor when your Flagship Bill arrives in Week 6. Just... don't double-cross my clipboard.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_hedge.text: Heh. Careful, rookie. If your Caucus standing sinks too low, your Week 6 Flagship Bill will need FOUR votes instead of three. I'll be watching the tally board.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_refuse.text: Oh, an idealist! Charming. Remember how lonely backbench exile feels when you need committee clearance in Week 6.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: An embossed silk envelope slid under your door—Vesper Viper requests two minutes.

n1.text: Good morning, Representative Barker. Vesper Viper, Senior Counsel on K-Street. Today's River Bridge bill saddles local riverside workshops with pricey new runoff rules. Vote NAY—your Main Street shops will thank you, and your War Chest will stay comfortably full.

choices.label: Promise a NAY—campaigns and small shops both need breathing room.
I'll 'review the riverside economic impact' first.
Show yourself out, Viper. Maple Creek families need clean water and a free bridge.

n2_deal.text: Exquisite pragmatism. Keep your promise on the floor and consider me a loyal supporter. Break it, and my clients have remarkably long memories.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_hedge.text: Ah—fluent Capitolese for 'sharpen your offer.' Just remember, Barnaby: running on fumes when primary season starts is fatal.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_refuse.text: How delightfully noble! Best of luck answering prime-time attack ads with an empty War Chest.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: Rep. Wilbur Troughman is flagging you down outside the dining room.

n1.text: Barnaby! My favorite freshman! Today's Rail Depot & Library bill brings 150 jobs straight to your downtown shops—AND includes a modest concrete contract for my county. Back it with an AYE, and I'll owe you a Favor for Week 6!

choices.label: Main Street needs those jobs—promise AYE. Remember me in Week 6, Wilbur.
Wait—what's the catch for folks living near the rail spur?
Keep your $38M earmark off Maple Creek's bills.

n2_ask.text: Oh, just rezoning two sleepy blocks behind Oak Street for freight loading! Retirees might grumble, sure—but your Main Street merchants will build you a statue! Are you in?

choices.label: Fine. Promise AYE—just deliver on my Flagship Bill.
No deal, Wilbur. I'll decide on the floor.

n2_deal.text: Now THAT is how coalitions get built! Don't get cold paws on the floor!

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_refuse.text: Hmph! Check with Sal Viper before you kill 150 downtown jobs, kid—you might be surprised who's mad at you!

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: URGENT: Someone you double-crossed on a floor promise is pounding on your door!

n1.text: YOU SHOOK MY HAND, PROMISED YOUR VOTE, AND THEN DOUBLE-CROSSED ME ON THE FLOOR! Did you think nobody reads the roll call in Washington, Barker?!

choices.label: I'm sorry—I read the attachment at the last second and balked.
Your attachment hurt Maple Creek—I stand by my vote.
Calm down—I'll back today's Postal Efficiency bill to make it right.

n2_apologize.text: Word travels faster than gossip in this Capitol. Don't expect favors until your handshake actually means something.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_defiant.text: Bold bark for a freshman with split polls. Watch your flank when primary season rolls around.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_promise_again.text: One last chance, rookie. Burn us twice and we'll fly a polished primary challenger straight into Maple Creek.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: Chairwoman Beatrice Kodiak requests a quiet word in your office.

n1.text: Representative Barker. I have chaired the Rules Committee for thirty years. Today's Postal Efficiency bill arrives with heavy black redactions. Main Street likes the shipping discount, yet seniors may pay dearly for what sits beneath the ink.

choices.label: Thank you, Chairwoman. I intend to uncover every blacked-out line.
If I kill it, will you back my Flagship Bill in Week 6?

n2_respect.text: Good. Read what others try to obscure, and you may learn that institutional respect carries more weight than loud slogans.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_transactional.text: Do not haggle with the Rules Chair, young pup. Earn respect first; favors follow merit.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: Whip Fenrir Fang is blocking the elevator with a 1,204-page binder.

n1.text: Listen closely, Barker. Today's Omnibus bundles Main Street storm loans, county ambulances, and 'fiscal offsets' into one take-it-or-leave-it vote. Stamp AYE and keep your standing before Flagship Week. Stamp NAY and we'll tell every shop and retiree you blocked emergency aid.

choices.label: Fine—I'll vote AYE. Keep my standing safe before Week 6.
What exactly is buried on Page 1,204, Fenrir?
Forcing us to trade schools against ambulances is broken politics.

n2_cave.text: Sensible pup. Heads up—Mags Magpie is camped outside the doors with a six-second microphone.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_probe.text: Merely routine 'school-budget restraint and congressional catering.' Flip all three pages on the floor—and brace for the press ambush!

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_stand.text: Save the civics speech for Mags Magpie—she's waiting right outside the chamber doors!

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: IT'S FLAGSHIP WEEK! Decide whether to keep your bill pure or attach a colleague's rider for votes.

n1.text: Big day, Barnaby! Your Flagship Bill hits the floor today. Normally you need 3 votes (you start with 1)—though if Caucus Leadership froze you out, you'll need 4! A warm Maple Creek coalition gives +2 Hometown Pressure, or spend banked Favors—OR let one of us 'sweeten' your bill right now for +1 guaranteed vote!

encounters.deskAlert: BREAKING: A dazzlingly polished Fox is filming a campaign ad right outside your door!

n1.text: Hey there, Barnaby! Sterling Foxworth—your brand-new Primary Challenger! No hard feelings, pal. My hair tested at 94% favorability, and if your War Chest is running dry, my billboards are going to chew through Maple Creek support every single week from here to Election Day!

choices.label: Maple Creek voters see straight through a focus-grouped campaign.
Check my War Chest, Sterling—I can match your ad buys.
Wait—who's paying for all those glossy billboards along Highway 9?!

n2_grassroots.text: Ooh, love the hometown pluck! Now go untangle four negatives on H.R. 615 while my cameras roll!

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_money.text: Whoa, look at the rookie flexing donor cash! My ad editors are gonna love that clip.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_ask.text: A totally independent group called 'Citizens for Fresh Leadership.' See you on the ballot, Barnaby!

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: Vesper Viper is waiting with a 'campaign ethics proposal'—and an ad-war lifeline.

n1.text: Foxworth's billboards are brutal, aren't they, Barnaby? If your War Chest is running dry, today's Campaign Ethics Act is your lifeline. Ignore the redacted fine print, stamp AYE, and my donors will fund your television counter-blitz overnight.

choices.label: I can't fight Foxworth broke. Promise AYE.
An 'ethics' bill with blacked-out clauses? I'll scrub it myself.

n2_deal.text: Spoken like a survivor! Keep your word and the airwaves will be yours.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_refuse.text: Still principled while Foxworth owns every radio commercial in Maple Creek? Bold strategy.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: Chairwoman Kodiak stands at your door holding a wax-sealed endorsement letter.

n1.text: That glossy challenger is turning Maple Creek into a circus, Barker. I am prepared to endorse your reelection—worth a decisive swing on Election Night. Today's Bridge Omnibus holds my own 72-Hour Reading Rule, yet somebody hid 75-year no-bid contracts on Page 3. Expose it and vote NAY—even if truckers groan—and the Kodiak seal is yours.

choices.label: You have my word, Chairwoman. I'll block the rigged Page 3.
Main Street needs Highway 9 open—I can't pledge a NAY until I read it.

n2_pledge.text: Well spoken. Scrub the ink, hold the line, and brace for Mags Magpie in the hallway.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

n2_honest.text: Candor is rare here. Inspect Page 3 on the floor; if you vote NAY to strip the no-bid contracts, my endorsement will still be yours.

choices.label: Back to the Desk

encounters.deskAlert: ELECTION EVE: Three urgent closing-night options arrive before the final midnight vote!

n1.text: Barnaby! Polls open at sunrise tomorrow! One midnight vote left, and every faction is knocking with a final offer. Check Toby's Staffer Report to see where you're weakest—how are you closing your campaign?

choices.label: Host a Midnight Maple Creek Town Hall (+11 all 3 hometown blocs, -10 Funds)
Accept Viper's Last-Minute Ad Blitz (+22 Funds, -9 all 3 blocs)
Sign Whip Fang's Final Caucus Pledge (+19 Party, -7 all 3 blocs)

n2_grassroots.text: Sal Viper's bringing coffee, Mrs. Lupine's organizing carpools, and Boarwell is handing out voter guides! Now go handle H.R. 999!

choices.label: To the Final Floor Vote!

n2_snake.text: Barnaby... a velvet-briefcase check at 11 PM on Election Eve? Don't be surprised if the Ethics Board takes an interest.

choices.label: To the Final Floor Vote!

n2_wolf.text: The Caucus turnout buses will roll at dawn—though folks back in Maple Creek will notice whose leash you signed.

choices.label: To the Final Floor Vote!

promptByVote.aye: FLASH! Mags Magpie, Capitol Gazette! Rep. Barker, you just froze school repairs and TRIPLED congressional lunch perks! How do you face Maple Creek parents?!
promptByVote.nay: FLASH! Mags Magpie, Capitol Gazette! Whip Fang says you just voted AGAINST storm loans for Main Street and new county ambulances! Any comment?!
promptByVote.abstain: FLASH! Mags Magpie, Capitol Gazette! You seriously ABSTAINED on a 1,204-page bill?! Were you napping at your desk?!

choices.label: "Page 1,204 froze schools to triple lunch perks—pass clean aid & ambulances separately!"
choices.successText: Mags lowers her notepad: 'Whoa—sharp quote. Rewriting the morning front page!'
choices.failText: Mags cackles: 'YOU VOTED AYE ON IT, BARKER! That's going in 72-point bold!'

choices.label: "Main Street and seniors needed aid tonight—I'll file a standalone school-funding bill Monday!"
choices.successText: Mags squints: 'Slick framing. Fine—I'll run a photo of Main Street Bakery instead.'
choices.failText: Mags grins: 'You voted NAY and you're taking credit for storm aid? Instant meme!'

choices.label: "Look behind you—Rep. Troughman dropped his fountain pen!" (Bolt down the stairs)
choices.successText: Mags actually turns! You escape the hallway with only a mildly teasing cartoon.
choices.failText: Mags snaps a mid-air blur of your flapping bow tie. Instant viral front page.

pressAmbushes.timeoutHeadline: FROZEN PUP! BARKER STARES SPEECHLESS INTO FLASH CAMERA FOR SIX FULL SECONDS!

promptByVote.aye: FLASH! Rep. Barker! You just handed out 75-YEAR NO-BID CONTRACTS with zero audits! Was Highway 9 worth selling the treasury?!
promptByVote.nay: FLASH! Sterling Foxworth is already airing ads claiming you blocked emergency repairs for Highway 9 bridges! Your response?!
promptByVote.abstain: FLASH! Election is next week and you ABSTAINED on Maple Creek's bridges! Who are you trying to please?!

choices.label: "I blocked 75-year no-bid corruption—pass a clean Highway 9 bridge bill right now!"
choices.successText: Mags whistles: 'Kodiak's backing that line too! Foxworth's attack ad just fell flat!'
choices.failText: Mags flashes her bulb: 'You literally just voted AYE for those no-bid contracts! Front page!'

choices.label: "Maple Creek trucks needed safe bridges tonight—I'll demand Page 3 audits on Monday!"
choices.successText: Mags shrugs: 'Smooth pivot. Half the town will give you the benefit of the doubt.'
choices.failText: Mags laughs: 'Auditing a bill you just voted down?! Classic Capitol word salad!'

choices.label: "No comment—see you at the ballot box, Mags!"
choices.failText: Mags grins wickedly: 'In print, No Comment ALWAYS reads like a guilty plea!'

pressAmbushes.timeoutHeadline: BARKER SPEECHLESS UNDER PRESS BULBS; FOXWORTH TURNS SILENCE INTO 30-SECOND AD!
